ज: já, vbl. born; born from; occasioned or produced by; only in cpds. [√jan, 333: cf. jā, the older form, 354.]
जगत्: jágat [450d], a. movable; as n. all that moves, men and beasts. [√gam: cf. 383b3 end.]
जघन: jaghána, m. n. the hinder parts, the buttocks.
जघन्य: jaghanyà, a. hindermost; last; lowest or worst. [jaghana, 1212d 4.]
जङ्गम: jaṅgama, a. movable; as subst. all that moves, equiv. to the ancient jágat. [√gam, 1148. 4, cf. 1002b.]
जङ्घा: jáṅghā, f. lower half of the leg, from knee to ankle; shin. [prob. fr. √1hā, ‘move,’ 1148. 4, cf. 1002b.]
जटा: jaṭā, f. matted hair; tangled locks.
जठर: jaṭhára, n. belly; womb. [akin are Goth. kilϸei, ‘womb,’ AS. cild, Eng. child.]
जन्: √jan (jā́yate [772]; jajā́na, jajñé [794d]; ájaniṣṭa; janiṣyáti, -te; jātá; janáyati, -te; ájījanat). see 761b end, and 772. 	—1. transitive, janáyati and active forms: beget; bring forth; generate or produce; 	—2. intransitive, jā́yate and middle forms: be born; be produced; come into being; be born again, 181; be, 862; jajñe, natus est, ortus est; jajñānās, children; for jāta, see s. v. [cf. γε-γον-ώς, ‘born,’ ἐ-γέν-ετο ‘became’; Lat. genui, ‘begat’; AS. cennan, ‘beget, bring forth’; AS. cynn, Eng. kin, ‘race, family’; AS. cyn-ing, Eng. king, ‘the man of (noble) kin’--for mg, cf. kulīna w. kula 2: cf. also jana and jani.] + abhi, pass. be born unto, be destined unto from birth. + ā, caus. cause to be born for some one, w. dat. + upa, mid. be born, arise. + pra, mid. be born; caus. procreate. + sam, mid. be produced; saṃjāta, having arisen.
जन: jána, m. creature; man; person; in pl. (e. g. 4016), and collectively in sing. (e. g. 7711), folks; a people or race or tribe; daívya jána, heavenly race, the gods. [√jan: cf. γένος, Lat. genus, Eng. kin, ‘race.’]
जनपद: jana-padá, m. (tribe-place, i. e.) district; community.
जनि: jáni [343c], f. woman; wife. [√jan: cf. γυνή, Eng. quean, ‘woman’: for mg, cf. jāyā.]
जनुस्: janús, n. origin; ingenium, nature; creation.  [√jan, 11542.]
जप्: √jap (jápati; jajā́pa; ájapīt; japiṣyáti; japitá, japtá; jápitum; japitvā́, japtvā́). say in under-tone; mutter.
जमदग्नि: jamád-agni, m. Jamadagni, a Rishi, friend of Viśvamitra, and foe of Vasishtha.  [jamant, unclear: see 13094.]
जरद्गव: jarad-gava, m. Old-bull, name of a vulture.  [jarant.]
जरद्दास: jarad-dāsa, m. old slave or servant. [jarant.]
जरत्: járant, ppl. aging; old. [√jṛ: cf. γέροντ-α, ‘old man.’]
जरन्त्: járant, ppl. aging; old. [√jṛ: cf. γέροντ-α, ‘old man.’]
जरस्: jarás, f. the growing old; old age. [√jṛ: cf. γῆρας, ‘old age.’]
जस्: √jas (jásyati; jajā́sa; jāsáyati). be exhausted or tired to death; caus. exhaust; quench.
जा: jā́ [352], vbl. born, at end of cpds. [√jan or jā: cf. já, later form of jā́.]
जात: jātá, ppl. born; grown; come into being, present; at beg. of cpds: arisen, existing, manifest; produced, aroused; as n. a living being; birth. [√jan, 955b.]
जातरूप: jāta-rūpa, a. having native beauty; splendid; -pá, n. gold.
जातविश्वास: jāta-viśvāsa, a. having arisen confidence,  inspired with confidence.
जातवेदस्: jātá-vedas, m. Jātavedas, epithet of Agni. [perhaps, ‘having knowledge of all beings, i. e. of gods and men,’ or, better, ‘having all beings or things as his possession. ’]
जातसंकल्प: jāta-saṃkalpa, a. having a purpose or desire arisen, feeling a passion for another.
जातामर्ष: jātāmarṣa, a. having anger aroused, vexed. [amarṣa.]
जातावमान: jātāvamāna, a. having arisen contempt, filled with self-contempt. [avamāna.]
जाति: jāti, f. birth; position or rank. [√jan, 11571.]
जातिमात्र: jāti-mātra, n. mere rank. [see mātrā 2, and 1302c 3.]
जातु: jā́tu, adv. at all, ever; na jātu, not at all. [√jan, 1111d: development of mg unclear.]
जातेर्ष्य: jāterṣya, a. having jealousy aroused, jealous. [īrṣyā.]
जानु: jā́nu, n. knee. [cf. γόνυ, Lat. genu, Eng. knee, whence kneel.]
जामदग्न्य: jāmadagnya, a. of Jamadagni; as subst. descendant of J. [jamádagni, 1211.]
जाया: jāyā́, f. wife. [√jan: for mg, cf. jani.]
जि: √1ji (jáyati, -te; jigā́ya, jigyé [787]; ájaiṣīt, ájeṣṭa; jayiṣyáti, -te; jeṣyáti, -te; jitá; jétum; jitvā́; -jítya). overpower; conquer; win (battles); win by conquest. [cf. βία, ‘force,’ βιάω, ‘to force’; Lat. vīs, *gvis, ‘force’: cf. √jyā.] + ud, conquer; be victorious. + parā, pass. be conquered. + vi, mid. be victor; conquer (conquests);  subdue.
√2ji (jinóti). enliven; quicken; hence [716], √jinv. [for *gvi: cf. βίος, ‘life’: see also √jīv.]
जिज्ञासा: jijñāsā, f. investigation. [‘effort to find out,’ fr. desid. of √jñā, 11494.]
जिताप्सरस्: jitāpsaras, a. having the Apsarases conquered, surpassing the Apsarases. [apsaras.]
जितेन्द्रिय: jitendriya, a. having the senses conquered,  having the passions subdued. [indriya.]
जिन्व्: √jinv (jínvati; jijínva; jinviṣyáti; jinvitá ). be lively, hasten; trans. quicken; speed onward. [secondary root fr. √2ji, see 716.]
जिह्वाग्र: jihvāgra, n. tip of the tongue. [agra.]
जीरदानु: jīrá-dānu, a. having swift drops, swift dripping, i. e. well watered.
जीव्: √jīv (jī́vati, -te; jijī́va, jijīvé; ájīvīt; jīviṣyáti, -te; jīvitá; jī́vitum; jīvitvā́; -jī́vya; jīváyati). live; be alive; caus. make alive. [see √2ji: cf. Lat. vīv-ere, ‘live’; AS. cwicu, ‘alive,’ Eng. quick, ‘alive, lively.’] + anu, live after, be dependent on, live upon.
जीव: jīvá, a. living; as m. the principle of life, the individual soul, 664. [√jīv: cf. Lat. vīvus, ‘alive.’]
जीवनहेतु: jīvana-hetu, m. cause of existence, i. e. means of subsistence.
जीवपति: jīva-pati or -patnī, a. f. having one's husband yet alive.
जीवप्रज: jīva-praja, a. having one's children yet alive. [prajā.]
जीवलोक: jīva-loká, m. the world of the living (as distinguished from that of the Manes), 8618, 2312.
जीवित: jīvitá, ppl. alive; as n. [1176a], life. [√jīv.]
जीवितव्य: jīvitavya, grdv. vivendum; as n. impers., see 999. [√jīv.]
जीविताशा: jīvitāśā, f. the wish for life, hope to save one's life. [āśā.]
जुष्: √juṣ (juṣáte, -ti; jujóṣa, jujuṣé; ájoṣiṣṭa; juṣṭá). taste, esp. with pleasure; relish; take pleasure in or accept graciously. [cf. γεύομαι, ‘taste’; Lat. gus-tus, ‘taste’; AS. ceōsan, Eng. choose.]
जुष्ट: júṣṭa, a. acceptable. [ppl. of √juṣ, w. accent altered as in dhū́rta.]
जुहू: juhū́ [356], f. sacrificial ladle for pouring the melted butter into the fire, cf. srúc. [√hu, 1147b2.]
जू: √jū (junā́ti [728]; jūjā́va [7864]; jūtá). speed, intrans. and trans.; incite, inspire; further, assist to. [cf. √2ji.]
जृ: √jṛ (V. járati; later, jī́ryati, -te; jajā́ra; ájārīt; jīrṇá [957b]). decay; grow frail or worn out or old. [cf. járant, ‘old,’ and γέροντ-α, ‘old man’; jarás and γῆρας, ‘old age.’]
जोगू: jógū [352], a. loudly singing; praising. [fr. intens. of √gu, 1147b2, 1002a.]
ज्ञ: jña, vbl. knowing, at end of cpds. [√jñā, 333.]
ज्ञा: √jñā (jānā́ti, jānīté [730]; jajñaú, jajñé; ájñāsīt [911], ájñāsta; jñāsyáti, -te; jñātá; jñā́tum; jñātvā́; -jñā́ya; jñāyáte; jñāpáyati, -te, jñapáyati, -te [1042d2]; jñaptá). know; have knowledge of a person or thing; recognize; become aware of; learn; notice. [cf. ἔ-γνω, Lat. co-gnōvit, ‘knew’; AS. cann, ‘have learned, i. e. know, am able,’ Eng. can; AS. ge-cnāwan, Eng. know.] + sam-anu, wholly acquiesce in; approve;  give leave; dismiss. + abhi, recognize; know. + praty-abhi, recognize. + ava, look down upon; despise. + ā, attend to, notice; caus. command. + pari, carefully observe; find out. + pra, know; esp. know one's way or bearings or how to go to work; prajñāta, clearly to be known, well known. + prati, recognize, allow; promise; affirm. + vi, distinguish; understand; know; recognize; consider as; observe; find out; --pass. vijñāyate, in stating a dogma, is well known or recognized (by good authorities);  --caus. make any one know or understand;  make a representation to, with a request or question or proposal; memorialize;  interrogate.
ज्ञाति: jñātí, m. kinsman; relative. [√jan: cf. κασί-γνητος, ‘brother-born.’]
ज्ञान: jñāna, n. knowledge; wisdom; esp. knowledge of the higher truths of religion and philosophy. [√jñā, 1150.]
ज्ञानिन्: jñānin, a. wise; possessing jñāna; understanding (what one reads), 6815. [jñāna.]
ज्ञेय: jñeya, grdv. to be known or considered as. [jñā.]
ज्या: √jyā or ji or jī (jinā́ti; jijyaú [785]; ájyāsīt; jyāsyáti; jītá). βιάω; overpower.  [cf. 1jyā́, ‘power,’ and √1ji, ‘overpower.’]
1jyā́, f. superior power; βία; force. [√jyā: cf. βία, ‘force.’]
ज्यायांस्: jyā́yāṃs, a. stronger or superior; older. [comp. of jyā, ‘being strong or superior,’ the vbl of √jyā, 4702, 3.]
ज्येष्ठ: jyéṣṭha, later jyeṣṭhá, a. best; principal; first; oldest. [superl. of jyā, the vbl of √jyā, 4703. see jyā́yāṃs.]
ज्येष्ठप्रथम: jyeṣṭha-prathama, a. having the oldest as the first.
ज्योतिष्मत्: jyótiṣmant, a. full of light; light. [jyotis: 184b.]
ज्योतिष्मन्त्: jyótiṣmant, a. full of light; light. [jyotis: 184b.]
ज्योतिस्: jyótis, n. light (of sun, dawn, etc.); as pl. the heavenly bodies; stars. [√jyut.]
ज्रि: √jri (jráyati). perhaps, go, stride; used only w. upa, stretch out to.
ज्वल्: √jval (jválati, -te; jajvā́la; ájvālīt; jvaliṣyáti; jvalitá; -jválya; jvāláyati, jvaláyati, -te). burn bright; flame; caus. kindle, make to flame. + pra, caus. kindle.
